Subject: Q2 Subscription Sounding: reconcile commit signals & renewal evidence

Hi Anna / Brightline team —

Quick check-in ahead of our Q2 commit close. We walked through Brightline in last week's renewal cadence and saw mixed signals across usage and procurement. Before I update SFDC and the forecast, can you confirm two things:

1) Has the procurement approval gone to legal or still with budget owners?
2) Any constraint on start date (previously June 1) or scope changes we should account for?

We're seeing a dip in active inference minutes in the last 6 weeks that flags churn-risk; if that's by design (workload migration) call that out so we don't overstate risk. I'll run a hygiene pass on the renewal row after your note.

If helpful, I attached the evidence sheet template for quick fill — one page with last six weeks usage and procurement milestone.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the nudge. Quick answers:
- Procurement has approved the spend in principle; legal is finalizing T&Cs but that's expected to complete by 25 Mar.
- Start date remains targeted for 2027-06-01; no scope reduction planned.
- The usage dip you flagged is due to a short maintenance window and a temporary router migration — we expect metrics to normalize by mid-April.

I've completed the evidence sheet and attached the updated SOW (internal filename Brightline_MAAP_SOW_v3.pdf). I've also flagged the legal owner on the DocuSign checklist for visibility.

If you want to lock in the renewal probability I recommend leaving it at 85% for now and revisit post-legal sign-off.

—Anna
Head of Platform Ops | Brightline
